summary: Retested the iteration_3 follow-up fixes; all of them are verified. fetch_news retries 3 times on 429/5xx. A unit test mocked 503,503,200 and got 3 calls with success; all-429 gave 3 calls then a 502. /api/img now rejects '..' and backslash in src with 400 (4 variants). '%2e%2e' gets 404 from upstream, which is harmless. Non-image upstream content returns 502, checked through TestClient with mocked httpx; render_webp raises UnidentifiedImageError. PIL work runs in asyncio.to_thread. 6 parallel cold requests for the same image after clearing /tmp/ynnck-img all returned 200 with valid WEBP and no leftover .tmp files (3 runs out of 3). UI: on desktop 1920 the 'Nostalgie Vlaanderen/België' card now breaks after '/' ('Nostalgie Vlaanderen/' then 'België'). The <wbr> is present and overflow-wrap is break-word. Regression: home shows 4 cards and every proxied image decodes at 800px. All 4 detail pages load their 1600px hero, the 3f4564a9 body image loads at 1200, the OVB video has readyState=4, each 'More work' section shows 3 proxied cards, and there were no console errors and no 4xx/5xx responses. One new finding: the cold first request for the slow upstream object 3f4564a9 (2.6MB) can take longer than the preview ingress's ~60s timeout, so the ingress returns an HTML 502.

minor.issue: Hetzner object 3f4564a9..._7cc40e74.jpeg is very slow upstream: direct curl took 15-40s and once returned 504 after 60s. The /api/img retry loop (5 attempts, 30s per-operation httpx timeout plus backoff) has no overall deadline, so a cold request can run past the ingress ~60s limit. The client then gets an ingress HTML 502, even though a direct localhost call succeeded in 28s and cached the image. This made test_img_all_cards fail in one full-suite run and pass in others. Suggestions: put an overall deadline on the fetch (e.g. asyncio.wait_for ~45s); finish the download and cache in the background even if the client disconnects; deduplicate in-flight fetches per key so concurrent cold requests don't each download the same multi-MB file; optionally pre-warm the cache at startup for the article images.
The retry loop also sleeps after the last failed attempt, adding up to 1.6s (fetch_news) or 6.4s (img) of latency before the 502. Cosmetic.

IMG_CACHE.mkdir runs only at import time; if /tmp/ynnck-img is removed while the server runs (tmp cleanup), every render fails with OSError -> 502 until restart. Call mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) inside render_webp.

integration_issues.issue: Still served directly from object storage (known, accepted). It loaded fine.

action_items: Optional: give /api/img an overall fetch deadline under the ingress timeout, plus in-flight dedup and background completion and caching, so slow upstream objects (3f4564a9) don't surface as ingress 502 on a cold cache
Optional: drop the sleep after the final retry attempt; recreate the cache dir lazily
critical_code_review_comments: No in-flight request coalescing in /api/img: N concurrent cold requests mean N upstream downloads of the same multi-MB file. That is correct now, but wasteful and adds load on an already rate-limited (SlowDown) bucket
Disk cache has no eviction (acceptable for this small number of images)
